story: Sophie and her friend Mia are at the park. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie's big yellow kite is stuck in a tall tree. Mia finds a long stick on the grass. [gesture:clapping] Sophie and Mia use the stick together and the kite comes down. [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:embrace] Sophie is so happy and hugs her kind friend Mia.
